annotations.title: Hide or unhide an ad comment

description: Hide or unhide an ad comment. Spending/deletion: preview, then owner-approved confirm:true with the same requestId. Other edits: one call. Creates request active; report returned status and claim live only when active. Full field guide: soclo://tools/soclo_ads_hide_ad_comment.

accountId.description: The connected ad account in Soclo.

adAccountId.description: Advertiser/ad account selected from your Soclo connection.

confirm.description: True only after owner approval of spending/deletion preview.

expectedBudgetAmount.description: Approved preview amount; changes require a new preview.

expectedBudgetType.description: Approved preview budget type: daily or lifetime.

hidden.description: True to hide the comment; false to restore it.

requestId.description: Reuse this request ID for confirmation and outcome recovery.
